notes: Conservative communication tier capacities for first-pass CubeSat optimization.
nominal_supported_downlink_mbps is a conservative achievable nominal downlink capability proxy (effective throughput is handled separately via downlink_efficiency_factor).
pointing_dependency indicates whether the tier typically requires at least MEDIUM/HIGH ADCS for stable pointing (narrower beams).

field_descriptions.nominal_supported_downlink_mbps: Nominal supported downlink rate for feasibility screening; effective throughput is nominal * downlink_efficiency_factor * usable_contact_fraction in system analysis.
field_descriptions.pointing_dependency: LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/EXTREME indicating the minimum practical ADCS tier to support the comm tier.
field_descriptions.tx_peak_power_w: Peak transmit power draw proxy contributing to P_peak_total.
field_descriptions.tx_avg_power_w: Average transmit subsystem power draw proxy contributing to P_avg_total under comm duty assumptions.
